bug.title: stale ROI freshness is measured from the poll clock, not the detection time
bug.mechanism: RoiHold.box() sets _at=now on every non-empty point list (exposure.py:174-189); _auto_expose feeds it snap['detections'] = deepcopy of _last_detections (controller.py:5389), which only updates on ingest (controller.py:1770/1830/2034/4783), while the preview image updates per frame (modern_window.py:1029) and the worker keeps previewing during a decision (worker.py:64-78)

stale_labelled_background_dark_result.reason: at limit: IR metering stale; holding

bug.impact: a decision lag/stall with the plate moved out of the last box can raise exposure from background (IR 1200->1500 us after 2 confirmations in the probe); fresh-01 measured p95 1.22 s / max 15.4 s decision latency; post-fix decisions <= 0.87 s bound the practical exposure
bug.fix: carry the ingest monotonic timestamp with detections and age the ROI from it

secondary.title: identical re-requests while a write is unconfirmed
secondary.mechanism: _pending/_unconfirmed only detect mismatch (exposure.py:531-556); no in-flight suppression in observe()
secondary.impact: a clamped/rejected write is re-emitted every 0.75 s while the condition persists (file rewrite, no device change)

minor: baseline write not registered in _pending/_unconfirmed -> a rejected baseline write is never reported as mismatch
baseline reset runs on the first GUI refresh after the capture child is already running; it cannot precede the first captured frames (archive_previous_output already removes the sticky file)
hard clip bypasses freeze/interval for both cameras (soft RGB can ride along)
